purpose.domain_detail: A multi-feature interactive terminal application themed around Fallout's 'Vault' and 'Pip-Boy', including login/registration, a library reader, arcade games (Hangman, Tic-Tac-Toe, random number guessing), a message board, weather, credits/banking, and an about page
purpose.summary: A large interactive terminal-based COBOL application styled as a 'Vault' system (Fallout-themed). It provides user authentication, a library with books, arcade games (Hangman, Tic-Tac-Toe), a message board, credit/balance management, and various utility screens. It calls numerous user-defined functions and manages multiple flat files for persistence.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with color attributes (FOREGROUND-COLOR, HIGHLIGHT, BLINK, UNDERLINE)
OCCURS ... DEPENDING ON for dynamic tables
Multiple ASCENDING KEY / INDEXED BY sorted tables
Multiple flat LINE SEQUENTIAL files (users, library, high scores, words, etc.)
186 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Pip-Boy ASCII art in SCREEN SECTION
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
